card.name: Start of a new sentence or section
card.fires_on: The first word right after a sentence has ended, especially when it begins a new topic or a new article. The word is often a capitalized noun or a lowercase fragment such as Mail, Washington, from or of.

modes.label: Sentence-initial noun
modes.description: A capitalized noun opens a new sentence after a full stop.
modes.example: <<Mail>> would arrive at ten A.M., with

modes.label: Dateline or source start
modes.description: A place name or source word opens a new news item or citation.
modes.example: DNA of extinct frog revived <<Washington>>, March 18, 2

modes.label: Lowercase start after a stop
modes.description: A small lowercase word like of, from or and appears right after a sentence ending.
modes.example: <<of>> the Osage Reservation, and buyers of

card.writes: The promoted tokens suggest a push toward the word existing, but the effect is weak and unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the first word after a sentence or headline ends, as a new thought begins.
